prerequisites: submission and presentation of an individual semester work on a chosen topic in the field of aviation and space materials according to the specified requirements.
fundamentals in materials structure and composition (atomic and molecular structure, crystal lattice and defects, phases and phase transformation)
physical and mechanical properties of materials (strength, deformation, fracture mechanics, fatigue, creep)
syllabus_topics: Specifics and requirements for aviation materials basic material properties, methods of processing materials
Fatigue effect of cyclic loading on material properties, fatigue damage characteristics
Creep effect of elevated temperatures on material properties, characteristic of creep damage
Degradation processes environmental effects (moisture, UV radiation, corrosion, wear)
Methods of protection of aircraft materials
Qualitative fractography basic description of fractographic methods, morphology of fracture surfaces
Aluminum and its alloys characteristics, properties and classification, usage in aviation
Magnesium and its alloys characteristics, properties and classification, usage in aviation
Titanium and its alloys characteristics, properties and basic classification, usage in aviation
Iron and iron alloys high-strength, corrosion-resistant and refractory materials for aerospace applications
Alloys based on nickel and cobalt materials for high-temperature applications
Non-metallic materials polymer and composite systems, ceramic-based materials
Additive manufacturing 3D printed materials, their properties and usage in the aerospace industry
